meta.data: Kaveri Finance is made up. Every name and ID number is invented test data.

results.title: Retrieval-augmented answers: a company assistant retrieves chunks with no permission check, and a support agent asks about 'salary review'
results.expected_in_words: The answer contains the HR salary-band text, because nothing checked who was asking

results.title: The permission is only a sentence in the prompt ('do not reveal HR files'); restricted chunks are still sent to the model and the user asks for them directly
results.expected_in_words: The restricted text is in the model's context and comes out; an instruction is not a control

results.title: Chunks are filtered by the person's live permissions before retrieval, and the same question is asked
results.expected_in_words: No restricted chunk is retrieved, and the answer is still built from the public FAQ the person may read

results.title: A person moves team; the chunk index still holds their old permissions. Asked once before the index refresh and once after, with a live check at question time as a third variant
results.expected_in_words: The stale copy leaks until it is refreshed; a check against the live directory holds straight away

results.title: A document the person may read hides an instruction to send the salary file by email; the assistant (assumed fooled) tries to send
results.expected_in_words: The send action is not on the list for this agent, so the gateway refuses and nothing leaves

results.title: An answer cache is shared between users: an HR person asks first, then a support agent asks the same question
results.expected_in_words: The support agent gets the cached HR answer; a cache keyed by the person's permissions does not

results.title: The answer text is withheld for restricted documents, but the answer still lists their titles as sources
results.expected_in_words: Titles such as 'Salary review 2026' are visible to someone with no right to know the file exists

results.title: Documents hold Aadhaar and PAN numbers; the index is built after a masking step at ingestion, and a person searches for a full Aadhaar number
results.expected_in_words: The number was masked before it was embedded, so searching for it finds nothing and the trace holds none

results.title: A document is deleted for an erasure request; the same question is asked before and after the index is rebuilt
results.expected_in_words: The deleted text can still be retrieved until the delete reaches the index; after the rebuild it is gone

results.title: Two documents the person may read, one with a name and one with an anonymous salary band, combine in one answer into a restricted fact
results.expected_in_words: Every check passes. This is a limit: permissions on single documents do not stop what the combination reveals

results.title: The retrieval trace is kept for debugging: one variant stores the full text of every chunk, another stores ids and hashes only
results.expected_in_words: A log of chunk text becomes a second copy of the restricted data; a log of ids and hashes does not

results.title: An agent answers on behalf of a support person: once using its own broad service identity, once using the person's permissions
results.expected_in_words: With its own broad identity the agent reads what the person may not; acting on behalf of the person it sees only what they see
